spec.sourceRegion: Question 5, coordinate diagram with eight arrowed coordinate blanks
spec.description: Square light-grey unit grid with black double-ended axes and italic x and y. Origin labelled O below-left. Filled dark dots at the eight labelled points plus an unlabelled dot at (0,4). Coordinate labels contain blank underlines, with thin arrows pointing from labels to their dots. Place a at upper-right, b lower-right near y=-2, c lower-right near y=-3, d below-right near y=-5, e lower-left near y=-3, f upper-left near y=2, g upper-left near y=5, h right of the y-axis near y=2. Preserve blanks without displaying answers.
spec.mathematics: Grid x,y from -6 to 6, equal unit scales. Label nonzero ticks -4 through 4 on both axes. Dot/label pairs: (3,3) a(3,__); (3,-1) b(3,__); (1,-2) c(1,__); (0,-4) d(__,-4); (-2,-1) e(__,-1); (-3,0) f(-3,__); (-3,3) g(__,3); (0,2) h(__,2). Additional unlabelled filled dot (0,4).
